reference_author: Codex implementation reviewer; fixed contract-rule labels authored before Mini inference; no economic labels
purpose: Regression of current versus deferred source requirements and exact duplicate identity; already-exposed family, no held-out model-quality claim.
budget_policy: Same per-run USD 0.10 maximum for all arms; checklist consumes zero model tokens. Shared campaign USD 2 including one discovery run. No retries or best-of selection.
failure_policy: Malformed, refused, timed-out and unstarted runs remain in the denominator.
aggregation: Paired template means. Four correlated regression templates; repetitions do not increase independent evidence. No significance claim.
scope_limit: The no-feedback comparison is deferred; this suite isolates the corrected requirement contract with structured feedback.
